answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces quadratic cryptographic stake burning for identity registration. Across an open meadow of decentralized peers, each node anchors its ferrous hardware attestation to burn proofs, illuminating genuine reputation like a guiding lantern while making mass clone deployment mathematically infeasible.
